title.zh: 卷四十五 志第二十一 地理六
title.raw: 卷四十五 志第二十一 地理六 Volume 45 Treatises 21: Geography 6

sentences.zh: 志第二十一 地理六

translations.literal: Treatise Twenty-One, Geography Six.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Twenty-One: Geography, Part Six.

translations.literal: ○ Fujian Guangdong Guangxi
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Fujian, Guangdong, and Guangxi

translations.literal: Fujian, in the Tribute of Yu, was the domain of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian fell within Yang Province as described in the Tribute of Yu.

sentences.zh: 元置福建道宣慰使司，治福州路。

translations.literal: Yuan established the Fujian Circuit Pacification Commission, seated at Fuzhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established the Fujian Circuit Pacification Commission with its seat at Fuzhou Route.

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: It was subordinate to the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 至正十六年正月改宣慰司爲行中書省。

translations.literal: Zhizheng sixteenth year first month changed the Pacification Commission to a Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Zhizheng 16 the Pacification Commission was converted into a Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太祖吳元年十二月平陳友定。

translations.literal: Taizu Wu year twelfth month pacified Chen Youding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the Taizu Wu year Chen Youding was pacified.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年五月仍置福建等處行中書省。

translations.literal: Hongwu second year fifth month again established the Fujian Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 2 the Fujian Branch Secretariat was re-established.

translations.literal: Seventh year second month established Fuzhou Regional Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 7 the Fuzhou Regional Guard was established.

translations.literal: Co-administered with the Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: It was co-administered with the Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八年十月改福州都衛爲福建都指揮使司。

translations.literal: Eighth year tenth month changed Fuzhou Regional Guard to Fujian Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 8 the Fuzhou Regional Guard was renamed the Fujian Regional Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 九年六月改行中書省爲承宣布政使司。

translations.literal: Ninth year sixth month changed the Branch Secretariat to the Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 9 the Branch Secretariat became the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 領府八，直隸州一，屬縣五十七。

translations.literal: Governing eight prefectures, one directly administered prefecture, and fifty-seven subordinate counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed eight prefectures, one directly administered prefecture, and fifty-seven counties.

translations.literal: Its area was three thousand seven hundred ninety-seven li.
translations.idiomatic: Its registered area was 3,797 li.

translations.literal: North to the ranges, bordering Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the north it reached the mountain ranges and bordered Zhejiang.

translations.literal: West to Tingzhou, bordering Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: To the west it reached Tingzhou and bordered Jiangxi.

translations.literal: South to Zhao'an, bordering Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: To the south it reached Zhao'an and bordered Guangdong.

translations.literal: East to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the east it reached the sea.

sentences.zh: 距南京二千八百七十二里，京師六千一百三十三里。

translations.literal: Distance to Nanjing two thousand eight hundred seventy-two li, to the capital six thousand one hundred thirty-three li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 2,872 li from Nanjing and 6,133 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十六年編戶八十一萬五千五百二十七，口三百九十一萬六千八百六。

translations.literal: Hongwu twenty-sixth year registered households eight hundred fifteen thousand five hundred twenty-seven, mouths three million nine hundred sixteen thousand eight hundred six.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongwu 26 registration there were 815,527 households and 3,916,806 persons.

sentences.zh: 弘治四年，戶五十萬六千三十九，口二百一十萬六千六十。

translations.literal: Hongzhi fourth year, households five hundred six thousand thirty-nine, mouths two million one hundred six thousand sixty.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 4 there were 506,039 households and 2,106,060 persons.

sentences.zh: 萬曆六年，戶五十一萬五千三百七，口一百七十三萬八千七百九十三。

translations.literal: Wanli sixth year, households five hundred fifteen thousand three hundred seven, mouths one million seven hundred thirty-eight thousand seven hundred ninety-three.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 6 there were 515,307 households and 1,738,793 persons.

sentences.zh: 福州府元福州路，屬福建道。

translations.literal: Fuzhou Prefecture: Yuan Fuzhou Route, subordinate to Fujian Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou Prefecture was the Yuan Fuzhou Route under Fujian Circuit.

translations.literal: Taizu Wu year made a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taizu Wu year it became a prefecture.

translations.literal: Governing nine counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed nine counties:

translations.literal: Min, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Min (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 南有釣台山，亦曰南臺山。

translations.literal: South has Diaotai Mountain, also called Nantai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Diaotai Mountain, also known as Nantai Mountain.

translations.literal: Southeast has Gushan.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Gushan.

sentences.zh: 南有方山，一名甘果山，下有官母嶼，有巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Fang Mountain, also called Ganguo Mountain; below is Guanmu Islet, with a patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Fang Mountain, also called Ganguo Mountain; below it lies Guanmu Islet, which has a patrol office.

translations.literal: Southeast borders the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The southeast borders the sea.

sentences.zh: 南有閩江，亦曰建江，自南平縣流入府界。

translations.literal: South has the Min River, also called the Jian River, entering the prefectural boundary from Nanping County.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Min River, also called the Jian River, which enters the prefecture from Nanping County.

sentences.zh: 東南納羣川之水，至府西曰洪塘江，分二流，南出曰陶江，東出曰南臺江，至鼓山下復合爲一。

translations.literal: Southeast receives the waters of many streams; reaching the west of the prefecture it is called Hongtang River, dividing into two flows—south out is called Tao River, east out is called Nantai River—then below Gushan they reunite as one.
translations.idiomatic: In the southeast many streams feed in; west of the prefecture this becomes the Hongtang River, which splits into the Tao River to the south and the Nantai River to the east, then reunites below Gushan.

sentences.zh: 又東南有馬頭江，自永福縣流入，曰西峽江，又東有東峽江流合焉，又東南至五虎門，入於海。

translations.literal: Further southeast is Matou River, entering from Yongfu County, called West Gorge River; further east is East Gorge River joining it; further southeast to Wuhumen, entering the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast the Matou River enters from Yongfu County as the West Gorge River; the East Gorge River joins it farther east, and together they reach Wuhumen and enter the sea.

translations.literal: East has Min'an Town patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Min'an Town patrol office.

translations.literal: Houguan, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Houguan (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 西有旗山，有雪峯山，有建江，又有西禪浦。

translations.literal: West has Qishan, has Xuefeng Mountain, has the Jian River, and also has Xichan Creek.
translations.idiomatic: To the west are Qishan, Xuefeng Mountain, the Jian River, and Xichan Creek.

sentences.zh: 西南有陽崎、吳山、鳳岡、澤苗、延澤、仙阪等六浦，皆建江支分，仍合正流入海。

translations.literal: Southwest has Yangqi, Wushan, Fenggang, Zemiao, Yanze, Xianban, and six other creeks—all branches of the Jian River that rejoin the main stream and enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest are Yangqi, Wushan, Fenggang, Zemiao, Yanze, Xianban, and five other creeks, all branches of the Jian River that rejoin the main stream before reaching the sea.

sentences.zh: 西北有懷安縣，洪武十二年移入郭內，與閩、侯官同治，萬曆八年九月省。

translations.literal: Northwest had Huai'an County; Hongwu twelfth year moved within the walled city, co-administered with Min and Houguan; Wanli eighth year ninth month abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'an County in the northwest was moved inside the city wall in Hongwu 12 and governed jointly with Min and Houguan; it was abolished in the ninth month of Wanli 8.

sentences.zh: 西北有竹崎、又有五縣寨二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northwest has Zhuqi, and also Wuxian Stockade with two patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest are Zhuqi and the Wuxian Stockade, which has two patrol offices.

translations.literal: Changle, prefecture east slightly south.
translations.idiomatic: Changle lies east and slightly south of the prefecture.

translations.literal: East borders the sea, with a sea dike.
translations.idiomatic: To the east it borders the sea and has a sea dike.

translations.literal: North has Matou River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Matou River.

sentences.zh: 又東有守禦梅花千戶所，洪武二十一年二月置。

translations.literal: Further east is the Meihua Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established Hongwu twenty-first year second month.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Meihua Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established in the second month of Hongwu 21.

sentences.zh: 東北有石樑蕉山、東南有松下鎮二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Shiliang Jiao Mountain, southeast has Songxia Town—two patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Shiliang Jiao Mountain; to the southeast is Songxia Town—two patrol offices.

sentences.zh: 又東有小祉山巡檢司，後移治大祉澳。

translations.literal: Further east is Xiaozhi Mountain patrol office, later moved to administer Dazhi Bay.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Xiaozhi Mountain patrol office, later moved to Dazhi Bay.

translations.literal: Fuqing, prefecture south slightly east.
translations.idiomatic: Fuqing lies south and slightly east of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan Fuqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Fuqing Prefecture.

translations.literal: Hongwu second year second month reduced to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Hongwu 2 it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 東南際海，有鹽場，海中有海壇山，又有小練山。

translations.literal: Southeast borders the sea, with salt fields; in the sea is Haitan Mountain, and also Xiaolian Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The southeast borders the sea and has salt fields; at sea are Haitan Mountain and Xiaolian Mountain.

translations.literal: South has Long River, and also Jing River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are the Long River and the Jing River.

sentences.zh: 東南有海口，江皆匯流入海。

translations.literal: Southeast has Haikou; the rivers all converge and enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Haikou, where the rivers converge and enter the sea.

sentences.zh: 又東有鎮東衛，東南有守禦萬安千戶所，俱洪武二十一年二月置。

translations.literal: Further east is Zhendong Guard, southeast is Wan'an Garrison Defense thousand-household post—both established Hongwu twenty-first year second month.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is Zhendong Guard; to the southeast is the Wan'an Garrison Defense thousand-household post—both established in the second month of Hongwu 21.

sentences.zh: 又有澤郎山、有牛頭門、又南有壁頭山三巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also has Zelang Mountain, Niutou Gate, and south has Bitou Mountain—three patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: It also has Zelang Mountain, Niutou Gate, and Bitou Mountain to the south—three patrol offices.

sentences.zh: 又東有海口鎮巡檢司，洪武二十年移於長樂縣之松下鎮。

translations.literal: Further east is Haikou Town patrol office; Hongwu twentieth year moved to Songxia Town in Changle County.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Haikou Town patrol office, moved in Hongwu 20 to Songxia Town in Changle County.

translations.literal: Lianjiang, prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Lianjiang lies northeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東北濱海，海中有北茭鎮巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast borders the sea; in the sea is Beijiao Town patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: The northeast borders the sea; at sea is the Beijiao Town patrol office.

translations.literal: South has Lian River, east entering the sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Lian River, which flows east into the sea.

sentences.zh: 東北有守禦定海千戶所，洪武二十一年二月置。

translations.literal: Northeast has Dinghai Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established Hongwu twenty-first year second month.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Dinghai Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established in the second month of Hongwu 21.

translations.literal: Luoyuan, prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyuan lies northeast of the prefecture.

translations.literal: East borders the sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the east it borders the sea.

sentences.zh: 西有羅川，南流分三派入海。

translations.literal: West has Luochuan, flowing south in three branches into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Luochuan, which flows south in three branches into the sea.

translations.literal: South has Yingde Town.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Yingde Town.

translations.literal: Gutian, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Gutian lies northwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 建江在縣南，自南平縣流入，經城南，有大溪流合焉，謂之水口。

translations.literal: The Jian River is south of the county, entering from Nanping County, passing south of the city; the Daxi stream joins it—called the Water Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: The Jian River lies south of the county, entering from Nanping County and passing south of the city where the Daxi stream joins it at a place called the Water Mouth.

sentences.zh: 又東南逕模天嶺下，江流至此始出險就平，東入閩清縣界。

translations.literal: Further southeast passing below Motian Ridge the river emerges from danger onto level ground, east entering Minqing County boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast, below Motian Ridge, the river leaves the rapids for level ground and flows east into Minqing County.

sentences.zh: 東有杉洋鎮，出銀坑，有巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: East has Shanyang Town, producing silver mines, with a patrol office, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Shanyang Town, which produced silver from mines and once had a patrol office, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 又西南有谷口鎮、西北有西溪鎮二巡檢司，尋廢。

translations.literal: Further southwest has Gukou Town, northwest has Xixi Town—two patrol offices, soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest is Gukou Town; to the northwest is Xixi Town—two patrol offices, soon abolished.

translations.literal: Minqing, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Minqing lies northwest of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Southwest has Damao Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Damao Mountain.

sentences.zh: 北有建江，西南有梅溪流合焉。

translations.literal: North has the Jian River; southwest the Mei stream joins it.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Jian River; from the southwest the Mei stream joins it.

translations.literal: East has Qingyao Town patrol office, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was the Qingyao Town patrol office, now abolished.

translations.literal: Yongfu, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Yongfu lies southwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西南有高蓋山，又南有陳山。

translations.literal: Southwest has Gaogai Mountain, further south has Chen Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Gaogai Mountain; farther south is Chen Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東有東溪，匯諸山溪之水，下流會於福清之龍江而入海。

translations.literal: East has Dongxi, gathering the mountain streams, flowing down to join at Fuqing's Long River and enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Dongxi, which gathers mountain streams and flows down to join the Long River at Fuqing before entering the sea.

sentences.zh: 又有漈門巡檢司，後移於嵩口埕，尋復故。

translations.literal: Also has Jimen patrol office, later moved to Songkouying, soon restored to the former site.
translations.idiomatic: It also had the Jimen patrol office, later moved to Songkouying and soon restored to its former site.

sentences.zh: 興化府元興化路，屬福建道宣慰司。

translations.literal: Xinghua Prefecture: Yuan Xinghua Route, subordinate to Fujian Circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Xinghua Prefecture was the Yuan Xinghua Route under the Fujian Circuit Pacification Commission.

translations.literal: Hongwu first year made a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture.

translations.literal: Governing two counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties.

sentences.zh: 北距布政司二百八十里。

translations.literal: North, distance to the Provincial Administration Commission two hundred eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 280 li north of the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Putian, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Putian (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 東南濱海，海中有湄洲嶼，又有南日山，俱東與琉球國相望。

translations.literal: Southeast borders the sea; in the sea is Meizhou Islet, and also Nanri Mountain—both east facing the Ryukyu country across the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The southeast borders the sea; offshore are Meizhou Islet and Nanri Mountain, both facing the Ryukyu realm to the east across the sea.

sentences.zh: 又南有木蘭溪，北有延壽溪，東北有荻蘆溪，又有通應港，俱會流入海。

translations.literal: Further south is Mulan Creek, north is Yanshou Creek, northeast is Dili Creek, and also Tongying Harbor—all meeting and entering the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is Mulan Creek; to the north is Yanshou Creek; to the northeast is Dili Creek; and Tongying Harbor—all converging to enter the sea.

sentences.zh: 又西北有興化縣，正統十三年四月省。

translations.literal: Further northwest had Xinghua County, abolished fourth month Zhengtong thirteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: Xinghua County in the northwest was abolished in the fourth month of Zhengtong 13.

sentences.zh: 東有平海衛，東南有守禦莆禧千戶所，俱洪武二十一年二月置。

translations.literal: East has Pinghai Guard, southeast has Puxi Garrison Defense thousand-household post—both established Hongwu twenty-first year second month.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Pinghai Guard; to the southeast is the Puxi Garrison Defense thousand-household post—both established in the second month of Hongwu 21.

sentences.zh: 東有嵌頭、西北有大洋寨、東南有吉了三巡檢。

translations.literal: East has Qiantou, northwest has Dayang Stockade, southeast has Jile—three patrol posts.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Qiantou; to the northwest is Dayang Stockade; to the southeast is Jile—three patrol posts.

sentences.zh: 東有衝沁巡檢司，本治尋陽，後徙興福。

translations.literal: East has Chongqin patrol office, originally administered Xunyang, later moved to Xingfu.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Chongqin patrol office, originally at Xunyang and later moved to Xingfu.

sentences.zh: 又有青山巡檢司，本治武盛裏南哨，後徙奉國裏。

translations.literal: Also has Qingshan patrol office, originally at Wushengli Nanshao, later moved to Fengguoli.
translations.idiomatic: It also has the Qingshan patrol office, originally at Wushengli Nanshao and later moved to Fengguoli.

sentences.zh: 東南有南日山巡檢司，後徙新安。

translations.literal: Southeast has Nanri Mountain patrol office, later moved to Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Nanri Mountain patrol office, later moved to Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 東北有迎仙寨巡檢司，後移鼓樓山。

translations.literal: Northeast has Yingxian Stockade patrol office, later moved to Guloushan.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Yingxian Stockade patrol office, later moved to Guloushan.

sentences.zh: 東有峙頭、東南有小峙二巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: East has Zhitu, southeast has Xiaozhi—two patrol offices, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was Zhitu; to the southeast was Xiaozhi—two patrol offices, later abolished.

translations.literal: Xianyou, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Xianyou lies west of the prefecture.

translations.literal: North has Erfeng Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Erfeng Mountain.

translations.literal: Northeast has He Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is He Ridge.

sentences.zh: 南臨九鯉湖，湖在萬山中，下流入莆田縣界，合於延壽溪。

translations.literal: South overlooks Jiuli Lake; the lake lies among myriad mountains, flowing down into Putian County boundary and joining the Yanshou Creek.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lies Jiuli Lake amid myriad mountains; its outflow enters Putian County and joins the Yanshou Creek.

sentences.zh: 西有三會溪，即木蘭溪上源。

translations.literal: West has Sanhui Creek, the upper source of Mulan Creek.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Sanhui Creek, the upper source of the Mulan Creek.

sentences.zh: 西有白嶺巡檢司，後遷於文殊寨。

translations.literal: West has Bailing patrol office, later moved to Wenshu Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Bailing patrol office, later moved to Wenshu Stockade.

sentences.zh: 南有楓亭市、西有潭邊市二巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: South has Fengting Market, west has Tanbian Market—two patrol offices, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the south was Fengting Market; to the west was Tanbian Market—two patrol offices, later abolished.

translations.literal: Jian'an, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Jian'an (seat-attached county).

translations.literal: Northeast has Fenghuang Mountain, producing tea.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Fenghuang Mountain, which produces tea.

sentences.zh: 東有東溪，即建江，自浙江慶元縣流經此，又西合於西溪。

translations.literal: East has Dongxi, namely the Jian River, flowing from Zhejiang Qingyuan County through here, further west joining the West Creek.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Dongxi—the Jian River—which flows from Qingyuan County in Zhejiang through this county and joins the West Creek farther west.

translations.literal: Further southeast has Shouling patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast is the Shouling patrol office.

translations.literal: Ouning, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Ouning (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 西有西溪，源出崇安縣，東會諸溪之水，流入縣境，又東合於東溪，南入延平府界。

translations.literal: West has West Creek, source in Chong'an County, east receiving many stream waters, entering the county boundary, further east joining East Creek, south entering Yanping Prefecture boundary.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is West Creek, which rises in Chong'an County, gathers tributaries from the east, enters the county, joins East Creek farther east, and flows south into Yanping Prefecture.

translations.literal: Northwest has Yingtou Street patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Yingtou Street patrol office.

translations.literal: Jianyang, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyang lies northwest of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Northwest has West Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is West Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東南有錦江，亦曰交溪，有二源，合流於縣東東山下，南流達於建溪。

translations.literal: Southeast has Jin River, also called Jiao Creek, with two sources joining east of the county below East Mountain, flowing south to reach Jian Creek.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Jin River, also called Jiao Creek, whose two sources unite east of the county below East Mountain and flow south to the Jian Creek.

translations.literal: Chong'an, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Chong'an lies northwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 南有武夷山，中有清溪，九曲流入崇溪。

translations.literal: South has Wuyi Mountain; within it is Qing Creek, nine bends flowing into Chong Creek.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Wuyi Mountain, where Qing Creek winds in nine bends into Chong Creek.

sentences.zh: 西北有分水嶺，上有分水關巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northwest has Fenling Ridge, atop which is Fenling Pass patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Fenling Ridge, with the Fenling Pass patrol office on its summit.

sentences.zh: 其水西流者入江西境，東流者入縣境，即崇溪源。

translations.literal: Its waters flowing west enter Jiangxi boundary; flowing east enter the county boundary—the source of Chong Creek.
translations.idiomatic: Waters flowing west enter Jiangxi; those flowing east enter the county as the source of Chong Creek.

sentences.zh: 俗謂之大溪，經城西而南出，亦謂之西溪。

translations.literal: Commonly called Great Creek, passing west of the city and exiting south, also called West Creek.
translations.idiomatic: Commonly called the Great Creek, it passes west of the city and flows out to the south, also known as West Creek.

sentences.zh: 其別源出縣東北之岑陽山，亦曰東溪，西南流合於西溪，又南合武夷水而入建陽縣界，即錦江之上源也。

translations.literal: Its separate source rises at Cenyang Mountain northeast of the county, also called East Creek, flowing southwest to join West Creek, further south joining Wuyi waters and entering Jianyang County boundary—the upper source of Jin River.
translations.idiomatic: A separate source rises at Cenyang Mountain in the northeast, also called East Creek, flows southwest to join West Creek, then south to merge with Wuyi waters and enter Jianyang County as the upper source of the Jin River.

sentences.zh: 又西北有溫林、岑陽、桐木、焦嶺、谷口、寮竹、觀音等關，與分水關爲崇安入關。

translations.literal: Further northwest have Wenlin, Cenyang, Tongmu, Jiaoling, Gukou, Liaozhu, Guanyin, and other passes, with Fenling Pass as the Chong'an entry pass.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest are the passes of Wenlin, Cenyang, Tongmu, Jiaoling, Gukou, Liaozhu, Guanyin, and others, with Fenling Pass as the main entry into Chong'an.

translations.literal: Pucheng, prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Pucheng lies northeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 北有漁梁山，建溪之源出焉。

translations.literal: North has Yuliang Mountain; the source of Jian Creek rises there.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Yuliang Mountain, where the Jian Creek rises.

sentences.zh: 又有蓋仙山，有黎嶺，又有楓嶺，一名大竿嶺，皆浙、閩通途。

translations.literal: Also has Gaixian Mountain, Li Ridge, and Feng Ridge—also called Dagan Ridge—all thoroughfares between Zhejiang and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: It also has Gaixian Mountain, Li Ridge, and Feng Ridge (also called Dagan Ridge)—all routes linking Zhejiang and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 又東北有柘嶺，與浙江麗水縣分界，柘水出焉，流合大溪。

translations.literal: Further northeast has Zhe Ridge, bordering Zhejiang Lishui County; Zhe water rises there and flows to join Great Creek.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast is Zhe Ridge, bordering Lishui County in Zhejiang; the Zhe River rises there and joins the Great Creek.

sentences.zh: 又南有南浦溪，亦曰大溪，即建溪也，下合建陽之交溪。

translations.literal: Further south has Nanpu Creek, also called Great Creek, namely Jian Creek, flowing down to join Jianyang's Jiao Creek.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is Nanpu Creek, also called the Great Creek—the Jian Creek—which flows down to join Jianyang's Jiao Creek.

sentences.zh: 東有高泉、東北有溪源、西北有盆亭三巡檢司。

translations.idiomatic: To the east is Gaoquan; to the northeast is Xiyuan; to the northwest is Penting—three patrol offices.

translations.literal: Songxi, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Songxi lies east of the prefecture.

translations.literal: East has myriad mountains.

translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Jiufeng Mountain, linking Pucheng with Longquan in Zhejiang.

translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Twenty-Four Districts patrol office.

translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast is the Chiyan patrol office.

translations.idiomatic: Shouning lies east of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東有蟾溪，即福寧州長溪上源也。

translations.literal: East has Chan Creek, the upper source of Chang Creek in Funing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Chan Creek, the upper source of the Chang Creek in Funing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東有漁溪巡檢司，後遷縣北之官台山，又遷斜灘鎮。

translations.idiomatic: Southeast of the city is Jian Creek—the Jian River, also called East Creek—which enters from Jianning Prefecture, passes Dandan Shoals to the south, then Jian Ford to the west where it joins West Creek.

translations.idiomatic: West Creek comes from the territories of Ting and Shao prefectures; west of the county it joins the Shaxi of Sha County at Shaxikou;

translations.literal: Further east reaching Jian Ford, joining East Creek;
translations.idiomatic: farther east it reaches Jian Ford and joins East Creek;

translations.literal: Further south reaching Youxi Ford, joining Great Creek, also called South Creek;

translations.literal: Further east reaching Fuzhou Prefecture, entering the sea;
translations.idiomatic: farther east it reaches Fuzhou Prefecture and enters the sea;

translations.idiomatic: it is commonly called the Three Creeks.

translations.idiomatic: To the south is Jiang Creek, also called the Great Creek—the upper source of West Creek.

sentences.zh: 又西北有梅溪，自邵武界流入，合於大溪。

translations.literal: Further northwest has Mei Creek, entering from Shaowu boundary, joining Great Creek.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest is Mei Creek, which enters from Shaowu and joins the Great Creek.

translations.literal: Further north has Wan'an Stockade patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north is the Wan'an Stockade patrol office.

translations.literal: Sha, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Sha lies southwest of the prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is You Mountain.

translations.literal: South of the county seat is Shaxi, also called Taishi Creek, entering from Yong'an County, passing east of the county, with Pili and other shoals, lower flow joining West Creek.
translations.idiomatic: South of the seat is Shaxi, also called Taishi Creek, which enters from Yong'an County, passes east of the county through shoals such as Pili, and joins West Creek below.

translations.literal: North has Beixiang Stockade patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Beixiang Stockade patrol office.

translations.literal: Youxi, prefecture south.
translations.idiomatic: Youxi lies south of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 北有丹溪嶺，一名桃木嶺，下有丹溪。

translations.idiomatic: To the north is Danxi Ridge, also called Taomu Ridge, below which lies Dan Creek.

translations.idiomatic: To the west are Yingguo Stockade and Gao Cai Slope—two patrol offices.

translations.literal: Shunchang, prefecture west slightly north.
translations.idiomatic: Shunchang lies west and slightly north of the prefecture.

translations.literal: South has Paihuai Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Paihuai Ridge.

translations.literal: Northwest has Shunyang Creek, source in Jianyang County, further east passing south of the county to join Jiang Creek, further east passing Shakou to join Shaxi of Shaowu County, further east passing west of the county to join West Creek—West Creek is the Ziyun Creek of Shaowu County—further east entering Nanping County boundary as Nanping's West Creek.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Shunyang Creek, rising in Jianyang County, passing south of the county to join Jiang Creek, then east through Shakou to join Shaowu's Shaxi, then west of the county to join West Creek (Shaowu's Ziyun Creek), and east into Nanping as Nanping's West Creek.

translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest is the Renshou Town patrol office.

translations.idiomatic: Yong'an lies southwest of the prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: It was originally the Fuliou patrol office of Sha County; in Zhengtong 14 the Yong'an thousand-household post was established here.

translations.idiomatic: Datian lies southwest of the prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest is the Taoyuan Shop patrol office, originally under Zhangping County and later transferred here.

translations.idiomatic: To the north was Ying Stockade; to the southwest was Anren Pass—two patrol offices, later abolished.

translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: It governed eight counties.

translations.idiomatic: There is also the Fengyi Guard, established in the eighth month of Hongwu 28 at Fengyi Subprefecture and relocated here in the fifth month of Zhengtong 6.

sentences.zh: 東北有大同、西北有泰川、西南有武林三巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Datong, northwest has Taichuan, southwest has Wulin—three patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Datong patrol office; to the northwest is the Taichuan patrol office; to the southwest is the Wulin patrol office.

sentences.zh: 又南有峒心、東南有三堆、東北有大峽、西北有平嶺四土巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also south has Dongxin, southeast has Sandui, northeast has Daxia, northwest has Pingling—four indigenous patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is the Dongxin indigenous patrol office; to the southeast is the Sandui indigenous patrol office; to the northeast is the Daxia indigenous patrol office; to the northwest is the Pingling indigenous patrol office.

translations.literal: Gui, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Gui County lies west of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元貴州，直隸廣西兩江道，洪武二年十月降爲縣，來屬。

translations.literal: Yuan Gui Prefecture, directly subordinate to Guangxi Liangjiang Circuit; Hongwu second year tenth month reduced to county, came under jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Gui Prefecture, directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit; in the tenth month of Hongwu 2 it was reduced to a county and came under Xunzhou Prefecture.

translations.literal: Nanshan Mountain is south.
translations.idiomatic: Nanshan Mountain lies to the south.

translations.literal: Also has east, west, north three mountains.
translations.idiomatic: There are also mountains to the east, west, and north.

sentences.zh: 南有鬱江，亦曰南江，羣川悉流入焉。

translations.literal: South has Yu River, also called South River; all streams all flow in there.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Yu River, also called the Nanjiang—all the streams flow into it.

sentences.zh: 有向武軍民千戶所，本向武守禦千戶所，洪武十八年十月置於向武州，三十年三月升軍民所，正統六年五月來遷縣北門外，萬曆二十三年又遷縣西北謝村鎮。

translations.literal: Has Xiangwu Military-Civilian thousand-household post, originally Xiangwu Garrison Defense thousand-household post, Hongwu eighteenth year tenth month established at Xiangwu Subprefecture, thirtieth year third month promoted to military-civilian post, Zhengtong sixth year fifth month relocated outside county north gate, Wanli twenty-third year again moved to Xiecun Town northwest of county.
translations.idiomatic: There is the Xiangwu Military-Civilian thousand-household post, originally the Xiangwu Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established in the tenth month of Hongwu 18 at Xiangwu Subprefecture; in the third month of Hongwu 30 it was promoted to a military-civilian post; in the fifth month of Zhengtong 6 it was relocated outside the county's north gate; in Wanli 23 it was moved again to Xiecun Town northwest of the county.

sentences.zh: 東南有新安寨、北有北山寨二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southeast has Xin'an Stockade, north has Beishan Stockade—two patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Xin'an Stockade patrol office; to the north is the Beishan Stockade patrol office.

sentences.zh: 又南有橋頭墟、西有瓦塘渡、又有五州寨、又有東鋋渡、又有郭東里五巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Also south has Qiaotou Market, west has Watang Ferry, also has Wuzhou Stockade, also has Dongting Ferry, also has Guodongli—five patrol offices, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south was the Qiaotou Market patrol office; to the west was the Watang Ferry patrol office; there were also the Wuzhou Stockade, Dongting Ferry, and Guodongli patrol offices—five patrol offices, all abolished.

sentences.zh: 又東南有三江城，萬曆中築。

translations.literal: Also southeast has Sanjiang City, Wanli period built.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast is Sanjiang City, built during the Wanli reign.

translations.literal: Liuzhou Prefecture: Yuan Liuzhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: Liuzhou Prefecture was the Yuan Liuzhou Route.

translations.literal: Hongwu first year made prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture.

translations.literal: Governing two subprefectures, ten counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed two subprefectures and ten counties.

translations.literal: Northeast distance to Provincial Administration Commission four hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 400 li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Maping, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Maping (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 元爲府屬，洪武元年徙府治於此。

translations.literal: Yuan was prefecture subordinate, Hongwu first year moved prefectural seat here.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to the prefecture; in Hongwu 1 the prefectural seat was moved here.

sentences.zh: 南有柳江，亦曰潯水，亦曰黔江，上流自貴州黎平府流入府境，下流至桂平縣合於鬱江，亦曰右江。

translations.literal: South has Liujiang, also called Xun Water, also called Qian River; upper flow from Guizhou Liping Prefecture enters prefecture territory, lower flow reaching Guiping County joins Yu River, also called You River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Liujiang, also called the Xun Water and the Qian River; its upper course enters the prefecture from Liping Prefecture in Guizhou; downstream at Guiping County it joins the Yu River, also called the You River.

sentences.zh: 南有新興鎮、都博鎮二巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Xinxing Town, Dubo Town—two patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are the Xinxing Town and Dubo Town patrol offices.

translations.literal: Also has Guihua Town patrol office, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Guihua Town patrol office, now abolished.

translations.literal: Luorong, prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Luorong lies northeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊治白龍巖，天順中，徙於硃峒。

translations.literal: Old seat at Bailong Rock; Tianshun period moved to Zhudong.
translations.idiomatic: The old seat was at Bailong Rock; during the Tianshun reign it was moved to Zhudong.

sentences.zh: 正德時，爲瑤、僮所據，嘉靖三年十一月復，萬曆四年正月遷於靈塘，以硃峒舊治爲平樂鎮，留兵百名守之。

translations.literal: Zhengde period, seized by Yao, Zhuang; Jiajing third year eleventh month recovered; Wanli fourth year first month moved to Lingtang, with Zhudong old seat as Pingle Town, left one hundred troops to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengde reign it was seized by Yao and Zhuang peoples; it was recovered in the eleventh month of Jiajing 3; in the first month of Wanli 4 the seat was moved to Lingtang, the former site at Zhudong was made Pingle Town, and a garrison of one hundred troops was left to hold it.

sentences.zh: 城南有洛清江，至馬平縣入於柳江。

translations.literal: South of city has Luoqing River, reaching Maping County enters Liujiang.
translations.idiomatic: South of the city is the Luoqing River, which at Maping County enters the Liujiang.

sentences.zh: 西南有江口鎮、又有運江二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southwest has Jiangkou Town, also has Yunjiang—two patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest are the Jiangkou Town and Yunjiang patrol offices.

sentences.zh: 東有平樂鎮巡檢司，治石榴江，後遷縣東北中渡。

translations.literal: East has Pingle Town patrol office, administered at Shiliu River, later moved to Zhongdu northeast of county.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Pingle Town patrol office, originally at Shiliu River, later moved to Zhongdu northeast of the county.

sentences.zh: 又西南有章洛鎮巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Zhangluo Town patrol office, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest was the Zhangluo Town patrol office, now abolished.

translations.literal: Liucheng, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Liucheng lies northwest of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Old seat south of Longjiang; Yuan was prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The old seat was south of the Longjiang; under the Yuan it was the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年遷治龍江東，而府徙治馬平縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu first year moved seat to Longjiang east, while prefecture moved seat to Maping County.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 the seat was moved to the east bank of the Longjiang, while the prefectural seat was transferred to Maping County.

sentences.zh: 龍江自天河縣流入，合於融江，即柳江上流。

translations.literal: Longjiang from Tianhe County flows in, joins Rong River, namely Liujiang upper flow.
translations.idiomatic: The Longjiang flows in from Tianhe County, joins the Rong River, and forms the upper course of the Liujiang.

translations.literal: East has Dongquan Town patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Dongquan Town patrol office.

sentences.zh: 北有古枿鎮巡檢司，初治融江東岸，後遷馬頭驛。

translations.literal: North has Guzhe Town patrol office, initially administered at Rong River east bank, later moved to Matou Post.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Guzhe Town patrol office, originally on the east bank of the Rong River, later moved to Matou Post.

sentences.zh: 又東北有古清鎮、西有洛好鎮、又有廖洞鎮三巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also northeast has Guqing Town, west has Luohao Town, also has Liaodong Town—three patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast is the Guqing Town patrol office; to the west is the Luohao Town patrol office; there is also the Liaodong Town patrol office.

translations.literal: Luocheng, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Luocheng lies northwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年十月以羅城鄉置，屬融州。

translations.literal: Hongwu second year tenth month established from Luocheng Township, subordinate to Rong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Hongwu 2 it was established from Luocheng Township, subordinate to Rong Prefecture.

translations.literal: Tenth year fifth month came under jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it came under Liuzhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 北有武陽江，下流合於融江。

translations.literal: North has Wuyang River, lower flow joins Rong River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Wuyang River, whose lower course joins the Rong River.

sentences.zh: 北有武陽鎮、又有莫離鎮、又有通道鎮三巡檢司。

translations.literal: North has Wuyang Town, also has Moli Town, also has Tongdao Town—three patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: To the north are the Wuyang Town, Moli Town, and Tongdao Town patrol offices.

sentences.zh: 又舊有安湘鎮、樂善鎮、中峒鎮三巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Also formerly had Anxiang Town, Leshan Town, Zhongdong Town—three patrol offices, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly there were also the Anxiang Town, Leshan Town, and Zhongdong Town patrol offices, all abolished.

translations.literal: Huaiyuan, prefecture north.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiyuan lies north of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan subordinate to Rong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Rong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武十年廢，置三江鎮巡檢司。

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year abolished, established Sanjiang Town patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Hongwu 10 and the Sanjiang Town patrol office was established in its place.

sentences.zh: 十三年十一月復置縣，來屬，治大融江、潯江之匯。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year eleventh month restored as county, came under jurisdiction, seat at Great Rong River, Xun River confluence.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Hongwu 13 the county was restored and came under Liuzhou Prefecture, seated at the confluence of the Darong River and Xun River.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十九年移治丹陽鎮。

translations.literal: Wanli nineteenth year moved seat to Danyang Town.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 19 the seat was moved to Danyang Town.

sentences.zh: 西北有九曲山，山南爲石門山，兩山夾峙。

translations.literal: Northwest has Jiujiu Mountain; south of mountain is Shimen Mountain; two mountains face each other.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest are Jiujiu Mountain and, south of it, Shimen Mountain—the two peaks face each other across a narrow gap.

sentences.zh: 福祿江自貴州永從縣流逕其中，至融縣爲融江，至柳城縣爲柳江。

translations.literal: Fulu River from Guizhou Yongcong County flows through between them; reaching Rong County becomes Rong River, reaching Liucheng County becomes Liujiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Fulu River flows through the gap from Yongcong County in Guizhou; at Rong County it becomes the Rong River, and at Liucheng County the Liujiang.

sentences.zh: 又東北有潯江，自湖廣靖州流合焉，有潯江鎮巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also northeast has Xun River, from Huguang Jing Prefecture flows joining there; has Xunjiang Town patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast is the Xun River, which flows in from Jing Prefecture in Huguang and joins there; there is the Xunjiang Town patrol office.

sentences.zh: 又西北有萬石鎮，又有宜良鎮、丹陽鎮三巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Wanshi Town, also has Yiliang Town, Danyang Town—three patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest is Wanshi Town; there are also the Yiliang Town and Danyang Town patrol offices.

translations.literal: Rong, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Rong County lies northwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元融州，直隸廣西兩江道。

translations.literal: Yuan Rong Prefecture, directly subordinate to Guangxi Liangjiang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Rong Prefecture, directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年十月以州治融水縣省入，來屬。

translations.literal: Hongwu second year tenth month with prefectural seat Rongshui County abolished and merged in, came under jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Hongwu 2 the seat-attached Rongshui County was abolished and merged in, and it came under Liuzhou Prefecture.

translations.literal: Tenth year fifth month reduced to county.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was reduced to a county.

translations.literal: Southeast has Lingyan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Lingyan Mountain.

translations.literal: North has Yunji Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Yunji Mountain.

sentences.zh: 其西曰上石門，以兩山夾峙，融江中流也。

translations.literal: Its west is called Upper Shimen; because two mountains face each other, Rong River flows between.
translations.idiomatic: To its west is Upper Shimen, where two mountains face each other and the Rong River runs between them.

translations.literal: Also east has Baoji Mountain, produces iron.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is Baoji Mountain, which produces iron.

sentences.zh: 東北有思管鎮、東南有清流鎮、西南有鵝頭隘三巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Siguan Town, southeast has Qingliu Town, southwest has Etou Pass—three patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Siguan Town patrol office; to the southeast is the Qingliu Town patrol office; to the southwest is the Etou Pass patrol office.

sentences.zh: 又北有長安鎮巡檢司，本在融江東岸，後遷西岸。

translations.literal: Also north has Chang'an Town patrol office, originally at Rong River east bank, later moved to west bank.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north is the Chang'an Town patrol office, originally on the east bank of the Rong River, later moved to the west bank.

translations.literal: Also has Dayue Town indigenous patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Dayue Town indigenous patrol office.

sentences.zh: 又有保江鎮、理源鎮、西峒鎮三巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Also has Baojiang Town, Liyuan Town, Xidong Town—three patrol offices, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There were also the Baojiang Town, Liyuan Town, and Xidong Town patrol offices, all abolished.

translations.literal: Laibin, prefecture south.
translations.idiomatic: Laibin lies south of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan subordinate to Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Xiang Prefecture.

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year fifth month came under jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it came under Liuzhou Prefecture.

translations.literal: Southwest has White Ox Cave.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is White Ox Cave.

translations.literal: North has White Cloud Cave.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is White Cloud Cave.

translations.literal: South has Great River, also called Duni River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Great River, also called the Duni River.

sentences.zh: 西有界牌鎮巡檢司，後遷縣南之南岡。

translations.literal: West has Jiepai Town patrol office, later moved to Nangang south of county.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Jiepai Town patrol office, later moved to Nangang south of the county.

sentences.zh: 象州元直隸廣西兩江道。

translations.literal: Xiang Prefecture: Yuan directly subordinate to Guangxi Liangjiang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Prefecture: Under the Yuan it was directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年十月來屬，以州治陽壽縣省入。

translations.literal: Hongwu second year tenth month came under jurisdiction, with prefecture seat Yangshou County abolished and merged in.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Hongwu 2 it came under Liuzhou Prefecture, and seat-attached Yangshou County was abolished and merged in.

translations.literal: West has Elephant Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Elephant Mountain.

translations.literal: East has Lei Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Lei Mountain.

translations.literal: South has Xiang River, namely Liu River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Xiang River, which is the Liu River.

translations.literal: Northeast has Longmen Stockade patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Longmen Stockade patrol office.

sentences.zh: 又有鵝頸鎮、尖山鎮二巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Also has E'jing Town, Jianshan Town—two patrol offices, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There were also the E'jing Town and Jianshan Town patrol offices, both later abolished.

sentences.zh: 西北距府百十三里，領縣一：

translations.literal: Northwest distance to prefecture one hundred thirteen li, governing one county:
translations.idiomatic: It lay 113 li northwest of the prefecture and governed one county:

translations.literal: Wuxuan, prefecture south.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxuan lies south of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan called Wuxian.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was called Wuxian.

translations.literal: Xuande sixth year renamed.
translations.idiomatic: It was renamed in Xuande 6.

translations.literal: Old seat at Yinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The old seat was at Yinjiang.

sentences.zh: 宣德六年三月徙於高立。

translations.literal: Xuande sixth year third month moved to Gaoli.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Xuande 6 it was moved to Gaoli.

sentences.zh: 東南有大藤峽，後名永通峽。

translations.literal: Southeast has Great Rattan Gorge, later named Yongtong Gorge.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Great Rattan Gorge, later renamed Yongtong Gorge.

sentences.zh: 西有柳江，又有都泥江，亦謂之橫水江，來入焉，下流爲潯州府之右江，亦入於柳江。

translations.literal: West has Liu River; also has Duni River, also called Hengshui River, flows in here; lower flow becomes Xun Prefecture's You River, also enters Liu River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Liu River; the Duni River, also called the Hengshui River, flows in here, and downstream becomes the You River of Xun Prefecture before rejoining the Liu River.

sentences.zh: 西北有安永鎮、西南有縣郭鎮二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northwest has Anyong Town, southwest has Xianguo Town—two patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Anyong Town patrol office; to the southwest is the Xianguo Town patrol office.

sentences.zh: 又東有東鄉、又有周衝、又有閒得三巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Also east has Dongxiang, also has Zhouchong, also has Xiande—three patrol offices, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east were the Dongxiang, Zhouchong, and Xiande patrol offices, all later abolished.

sentences.zh: 賓州元直隸廣西兩江道。

translations.literal: Bin Prefecture: Yuan directly subordinate to Guangxi Liangjiang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Bin Prefecture: Under the Yuan it was directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年九月以州治領方縣省入。

translations.literal: Hongwu second year ninth month with prefecture seat Lingfang County abolished and merged in.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Hongwu 2 seat-attached Lingfang County was abolished and merged in.

translations.literal: Tenth month came under jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month it came under Liuzhou Prefecture.

translations.literal: Southeast has Zhenlong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Zhenlong Mountain.

translations.literal: Southwest has Lamp Stand Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Lamp Stand Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西有古漏山，下有古漏關，古漏水出焉，入於賓水。

translations.literal: West has Gulu Mountain, below has Gulu Pass, Gulu Water rises there, enters Bin Water.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Gulu Mountain, below which lies Gulu Pass; Gulu Water rises there and flows into Bin Water.

translations.literal: Bin Water in south, namely Duni River.
translations.idiomatic: Bin Water lies to the south—it is the Duni River.

translations.literal: East has Ancheng Town patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Ancheng Town patrol office.

sentences.zh: 又東有樑村巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: Also east has Liangcun patrol office, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east was the Liangcun patrol office, later abolished.

translations.literal: North distance to prefecture three hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 300 li north of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Governing two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties:

translations.literal: Qianjiang, prefecture north.
translations.idiomatic: Qianjiang lies north of the prefecture.

translations.literal: West has Gudang Mountain, has caves.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Gudang Mountain, with cave settlements.

translations.literal: Northeast has Great River, namely Duni River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Great River, which is the Duni River.

sentences.zh: 東有遷江屯田千戶所，洪武二十五年九月置。

translations.literal: East has Qianjiang garrison-farm thousand-household post, Hongwu twenty-fifth year ninth month established.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Qianjiang garrison-farm thousand-household post, established in the ninth month of Hongwu 25.

sentences.zh: 東南有清水鎮巡檢司，又有羅目鎮、李廣鎮二巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Southeast has Qingshui Town patrol office; also has Luomu Town, Liguang Town—two patrol offices, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Qingshui Town patrol office; the Luomu Town and Liguang Town patrol offices were later abolished.

sentences.zh: 又東有石零堡，北有都歷堡，俱正德中築。

translations.literal: Also east has Shiling Fort, north has Dulie Fort—both Zhengde period built.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is Shiling Fort; to the north is Dulie Fort—both built during the Zhengde reign.

translations.literal: Shanglin, prefecture west slightly north.
translations.idiomatic: Shanglin lies west and slightly north of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西有大明山，澄江出焉，亦名南江，東合北江，又東入遷江縣之大江。

translations.literal: West has Daming Mountain, Cheng River rises there, also named South River; east joins North River, again east enters Qianjiang County's Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Daming Mountain, whence the Cheng River rises—it is also called the South River; flowing east it joins the North River, then farther east enters the Great River in Qianjiang County.

translations.literal: Xuande first year with Annam.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 1 it passed to Annam.

translations.literal: Lu Prefecture Yuan subordinate to Siming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Siming Prefecture.

translations.literal: Hongwu third year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Hongwu 3.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月復置，尋沒於交址。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year first month restored, soon lost to Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Hongwu 21 it was restored, but was soon lost to Jiaozhi.

translations.literal: Yongle third year recovered.
translations.idiomatic: It was recovered in Yongle 3.

translations.literal: Xuande first year with Annam.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 1 it passed to Annam.

translations.literal: Zhen'an Prefecture Yuan Zhen'an Route.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen'an Prefecture was the Yuan Zhen'an Route.

translations.literal: Hongwu second year made prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 it became a prefecture.

translations.literal: West has Zhen'an old walled city.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the old walled city of Zhen'an.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年徙於廢凍州，即今治也。

translations.literal: Hongwu second year moved to abolished Dong Prefecture, namely present seat.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 it was moved to the abandoned Dong Prefecture—the present seat.

sentences.zh: 南有馱命江，下流合鬱江。

translations.literal: South has Tuoming River, lower flow joins Yu River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Tuoming River, whose lower course joins the Yu River.

sentences.zh: 又有邏水，發源府北土山峽中，下流至胡潤寨，與歸順州之邏水合，有湖潤寨巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also has Luo River, source in prefecture north earthen mountain gorge, lower flow reaches Hurun Stockade, joins Guishun Prefecture's Luo River, has Hurun Stockade patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Luo River, rising in a gorge among the earthen hills north of the prefecture; flowing down to Hurun Stockade it joins the Luo River of Guishun Prefecture, where the Hurun Stockade patrol office stands.

translations.literal: Distance to Provincial Administration Commission two thousand two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 2,200 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Tian Prefecture Yuan Tianzhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Prefecture was the Yuan Tianzhou Route.

translations.literal: Hongwu second year seventh month made prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Hongwu 2 it became a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖七年六月降爲州，徙治八甲，而置田寧府於府城。

translations.literal: Jiajing seventh year sixth month reduced to prefecture, moved seat to Bajia, and established Tianning Prefecture at prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Jiajing 7 it was reduced to a prefecture and its seat moved to Bajia, while Tianning Prefecture was established in the former prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 八年十月，府廢，州復還故治，直隸布政司。

translations.literal: Eighth year tenth month, prefecture abolished, prefecture restored to former seat, directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Jiajing 8 Tianning Prefecture was abolished; Tian Prefecture returned to its former seat and came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Southeast has Nanpan River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Nanpan River.

sentences.zh: 西有來安路，元屬廣西兩江道，洪武二年七月爲府，領歸仁州、羅博州、田州，十七年復廢。

translations.literal: West has Laian Route, Yuan subordinate to Guangxi Liangjiang Circuit, Hongwu second year seventh month made prefecture, governing Guiren Prefecture, Luobo Prefecture, Tian Prefecture, seventeenth year again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Laian Route, which under the Yuan belonged to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit; in the seventh month of Hongwu 2 it became a prefecture governing Guiren, Luobo, and Tian prefectures, and was abolished again in Hongwu 17.

sentences.zh: 北有上隆州，元屬田州路，洪武二年屬府，成化三年徙治潯州府東北，更名武靖州。

translations.literal: North has Shanglong Prefecture, Yuan subordinate to Tianzhou Route, Hongwu second year subordinate to prefecture, Chenghua third year moved seat to northeast of Xun Prefecture, renamed Wujing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Shanglong Prefecture, which under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route; in Hongwu 2 it came under Tian Prefecture, and in Chenghua 3 its seat was moved to the northeast of Xun Prefecture and it was renamed Wujing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又有恩城州，元屬路，洪武初屬府，弘治五年廢。

translations.literal: Also has Encheng Prefecture, Yuan subordinate to route, Hongwu beginning subordinate to prefecture, Hongzhi fifth year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Encheng Prefecture, which under the Yuan belonged to the route and in the early Hongwu reign came under Tian Prefecture; it was abolished in Hongzhi 5.

sentences.zh: 東有牀甲、拱甲、婪鳳，西有武隆、累彩，北有岜馬甲、篆甲，東北有下隆，東南有砦桑，西北有凌時，西南有萬岡陽院，又有大甲、子甲，又有縣甲、怕河、怕牙、思郎、思幼、候周十九土巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Chuangjia, Gongjia, Lanfeng, west has Wulong, Leicai, north has Bamajia, Zhuanjia, northeast has Xialong, southeast has Zhaisang, northwest has Lingshi, southwest has Wangangyang Stockade, also has Dajia, Zijia, also has Xianjia, Pahe, Payai, Silang, Siyou, Houzhou nineteen native patrol offices.
translations.idiomatic: To the east are the Chuangjia, Gongjia, and Lanfeng native districts; to the west are Wulong and Leicai; to the north are Bamajia and Zhuanjia; to the northeast is Xialong; to the southeast is Zhaisang; to the northwest is Lingshi; to the southwest is the Wangangyang Stockade; there are also Dajia and Zijia, and nineteen native patrol offices at Xianjia, Pahe, Payai, Silang, Siyou, and Houzhou.

translations.literal: Distance to Provincial Administration Commission one thousand six hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 1,600 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Guishun Prefecture Yuan subordinate to Zhen'an Route.
translations.idiomatic: Guishun Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Zhen'an Route.

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning, abolished and made a native domain.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Hongwu reign it was abolished and reduced to a native domain.

sentences.zh: 弘治九年八月復置，屬鎮安府。

translations.literal: Hongzhi ninth year eighth month restored, subordinate to Zhen'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Hongzhi 9 it was restored and placed under Zhen'an Prefecture.

translations.literal: Jiajing beginning, directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jiajing reign it came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 東北有龍潭水，南入交址高平府界。

translations.literal: Northeast has Longtan Water, south enters Jiaozhi Gaoping Prefecture boundary.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Longtan Water, which flows south into the border of Gaoping Prefecture in Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 又南有邏水，發源西北鵝槽隘界。

translations.literal: Also south has Luo River, source northwest Goose Trough Pass boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is the Luo River, which rises on the border at Goose Trough Pass to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 距布政司二千三百二十里。

translations.literal: Distance to Provincial Administration Commission two thousand three hundred twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 2,320 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Sicheng Prefecture Yuan subordinate to Tianzhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: Sicheng Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route.

sentences.zh: 洪武七年直隸行中書省。

translations.literal: Hongwu seventh year directly subordinate to Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 7 it came directly under the Branch Secretariat.

translations.literal: Ninth year directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 9 it came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 舊州在西南，洪武六年移於古勘洞。

translations.literal: Old prefecture in southwest, Hongwu sixth year moved to Gukan Cave.
translations.idiomatic: The former seat lay in the southwest; in Hongwu 6 it was moved to Gukan Cave.

sentences.zh: 西有南盤江，自貴州慕役長官司流入，下流爲南寧府之右江。

translations.literal: West has Nanpan River, from Guizhou Muyi Native Official Office flows in, lower flow is Nanning Prefecture's You River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Nanpan River, flowing in from the Muyi Native Official Office in Guizhou; its lower course becomes the You River of Nanning Prefecture.

translations.literal: Also north has Red Water River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north is the Red Water River.

sentences.zh: 東北有程縣，洪武二十一年以泗城州之程醜莊置，屬州，尋屬慶遠府，宣德初，還屬州，嘉靖元年廢。

translations.literal: Northeast has Cheng County, Hongwu twenty-first year established from Sicheng Prefecture's Chengchou Manor, subordinate to prefecture, soon subordinate to Qingyuan Prefecture, Xuande beginning, returned to subordinate to prefecture, Jiajing first year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Cheng County, established in Hongwu 21 from Chengchou Manor in Sicheng Prefecture and first attached to the prefecture, then transferred to Qingyuan Prefecture, returned to Sicheng in the Xuande reign, and abolished in Jiajing 1.

sentences.zh: 西南有利州，元屬田州路，洪武七年十一月直隸布政司，正統六年五月徙治泗城州古那甲，嘉靖二年廢。

translations.literal: Southwest has Lizhou, Yuan subordinate to Tianzhou Route, Hongwu seventh year eleventh month directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission, Zhengtong sixth year fifth month moved seat to Sicheng Prefecture Guna Stockade, Jiajing second year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Lizhou, which under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route; in the eleventh month of Hongwu 7 it came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission, in the fifth month of Zhengtong 6 its seat was moved to Guna Stockade in Sicheng Prefecture, and it was abolished in Jiajing 2.

sentences.zh: 又西有上林長官司，永樂七年以州之上林洞置，直隸布政司，萬曆中，省入州，崇禎六年分司西地入雲南廣南府。

translations.literal: Also west has Shanglin Native Official Office, Yongle seventh year established from prefecture's Shanglin Cave, directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission, during Wanli, merged into prefecture, Chongzhen sixth year divided western territory into Yunnan Guangnan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Shanglin Native Official Office, established in Yongle 7 from Shanglin Cave in the prefecture and placed directly under the Provincial Administration Commission; during the Wanli reign it was merged into the prefecture, and in Chongzhen 6 its western territory was divided off into Yunnan's Guangnan Prefecture.

translations.literal: Has Luobo Pass patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: There is the Luobo Pass patrol office.

sentences.zh: 北距布政司一千八百一十五里。

translations.literal: North distance to Provincial Administration Commission one thousand eight hundred fifteen li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 1,815 li north of the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Xiangwu Prefecture Yuan subordinate to Tianzhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangwu Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年七月屬田州府。

translations.literal: Hongwu second year seventh month subordinate to Tian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Hongwu 2 it came under Tian Prefecture.

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Hongwu 28.

sentences.zh: 建文二年復置，直隸布政司。

translations.literal: Jianwen second year restored, directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in Jianwen 2 and came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Old prefecture in east.
translations.idiomatic: The former seat lay in the east.

sentences.zh: 萬曆四十五年遷於乃甲。

translations.literal: Wanli forty-fifth year moved to Naijia.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 45 it was moved to Naijia.

sentences.zh: 南有枯榕江，下流入於右江。

translations.literal: South has Kurong River, lower flow enters You River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Kurong River, whose lower course flows into the You River.

sentences.zh: 北有富勞縣，元屬田州路，洪武二年屬田州府，尋爲夷僚所據，建文四年復置，後廢。

translations.literal: North has Fulao County, Yuan subordinate to Tianzhou Route, Hongwu second year subordinate to Tian Prefecture, soon seized by tribal peoples, Jianwen fourth year restored, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Fulao County, which under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route and in Hongwu 2 came under Tian Prefecture; it was soon seized by tribal peoples, restored in Jianwen 4, and later abolished.

sentences.zh: 東有武林縣，元亦屬田州路，洪武二年屬田州府，永樂初省入富勞縣。

translations.literal: East has Wulin County, Yuan also subordinate to Tianzhou Route, Hongwu second year subordinate to Tian Prefecture, Yongle beginning merged into Fulao County.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Wulin County, which likewise under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route and in Hongwu 2 came under Tian Prefecture; at the beginning of the Yongle reign it was merged into Fulao County.

translations.literal: Distance to Provincial Administration Commission two thousand four hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 2,400 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Dukang Prefecture Yuan subordinate to Tianzhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: Dukang Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年屬田州府，後爲夷僚所據。

translations.literal: Hongwu second year subordinate to Tian Prefecture, later seized by tribal peoples.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 it came under Tian Prefecture, but was later seized by tribal peoples.

sentences.zh: 建文元年復置，直隸布政司。

translations.literal: Jianwen first year restored, directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in Jianwen 1 and came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 西有岜爐江，下流合於通利江。

translations.literal: West has Balu River, lower flow joins Tongli River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Balu River, whose lower course joins the Tongli River.

sentences.zh: 距布政司二千五百四十里。

translations.literal: Distance to Provincial Administration Commission two thousand five hundred forty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 2,540 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Long Prefecture Yuan Longzhou Wanhu Command.
translations.idiomatic: Long Prefecture was the Yuan Longzhou Wanhu Command.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年七月仍爲州，屬太平府。

translations.literal: Hongwu second year seventh month still made prefecture, subordinate to Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Hongwu 2 it remained a prefecture and came under Taiping Prefecture.

translations.literal: Ninth year sixth month directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Hongwu 9 it came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 南有龍江，自交址廣源州流入，即麗江也，有明江流入焉，下流爲南寧府之左江。

translations.literal: South has Long River, from Jiaozhi Guangyuan Prefecture flows in, namely Lijiang, has Ming River flows in there, lower flow is Nanning Prefecture's Zuo River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Long River, flowing in from Guangyuan Prefecture in Jiaozhi—it is the Lijiang; the Ming River also flows into it, and its lower course becomes the Zuo River of Nanning Prefecture.

translations.literal: Distance to Provincial Administration Commission two thousand three hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 2,300 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Jiang Prefecture Yuan subordinate to Siming Route.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Siming Route.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十年直隸布政司。

translations.literal: Hongwu twentieth year directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 20 it came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 東有歸安水，西有綠眉水，下流俱合於麗江。

translations.literal: East has Gui'an Water, west has Lümei Water, lower flows all join Lijiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Gui'an Water; to the west is Lümei Water; both flow down to join the Lijiang.

translations.literal: Governing one county.
translations.idiomatic: It governed one county.

sentences.zh: 距布政司二千一百十里。

translations.literal: Distance to Provincial Administration Commission two thousand one hundred ten li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 2,110 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Luobai Prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Luobai Prefecture lies to the northeast.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年置，屬思明府，後來屬。

translations.literal: Hongwu third year established, subordinate to Siming Prefecture, later came under jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Hongwu 3, it belonged to Siming Prefecture and later came under Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 南有隴冬水，下流入於麗江。

translations.literal: South has Longdong Water, lower flow enters Lijiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Longdong Water, which flows down into the Lijiang.

translations.literal: Siling Prefecture Yuan subordinate to Siming Route.
translations.idiomatic: Siling Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Siming Route.

translations.literal: Hongwu third year merged into Siming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 3 it was merged into Siming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月復置，直隸布政司。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year first month restored, directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Hongwu 21 it was restored and came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 南有角硬山，角硬水出焉，又有淰削水合之，下流入思明府界。

translations.literal: South has Jiaoying Mountain, Jiaoying Water rises there, also has Nixiao Water joins it, lower flow enters Siming Prefecture boundary.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Jiaoying Mountain, where Jiaoying Water rises; Nixiao Water joins it, and the stream flows down into Siming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 距布政司二千一百二十里。

translations.literal: Distance to Provincial Administration Commission two thousand one hundred twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 2,120 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Pingxiang Prefecture originally Pingxiang County.
translations.idiomatic: Pingxiang Prefecture was originally Pingxiang County.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年五月以思明府之憑祥鎮置，屬思明府。

translations.literal: Yongle second year fifth month established from Siming Prefecture's Pingxiang Town, subordinate to Siming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Yongle 2 it was established from Pingxiang Town in Siming Prefecture and placed under that prefecture.

sentences.zh: 成化十八年升爲州，直隸布政司。

translations.literal: Chenghua eighteenth year elevated to prefecture, directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 18 it was elevated to a prefecture and came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 西北有麗江，自交址廣源州流入。

translations.literal: Northwest has Lijiang, from Jiaozhi Guangyuan Prefecture flows in.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Lijiang, flowing in from Guangyuan Prefecture in Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 又南有鎮南關，一名大南關，即界首關也。

translations.literal: Also south has Zhennan Pass, one name Danan Pass, namely boundary-head pass.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is Zhennan Pass, also called Danan Pass—the pass at the border head.

translations.literal: Distance to Provincial Administration Commission two thousand forty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 2,040 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 安隆長官司元致和元年三月置安隆州，屬雲南行省。

translations.literal: Anlong Native Official Office Yuan Zhihe first year third month established Anlong Prefecture, subordinate to Yunnan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The Anlong Native Official Office: under the Yuan, Anlong Prefecture was established in the third month of Zhihe 1 and placed under the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.

translations.literal: Later abolished and made stockade, subordinate to Sicheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It was later abolished and reduced to a stockade under Sicheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武三十五年十二月置安隆長官司，仍屬泗城州，後直隸布政司。

translations.literal: Hongwu thirty-fifth year twelfth month established Anlong Native Official Office, still subordinate to Sicheng Prefecture, later directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Hongwu 35 the Anlong Native Official Office was established, still under Sicheng Prefecture and later coming directly under the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 西有壩達山，渾水河經其下，即紅水江也，東入泗城州界。

translations.literal: West has Bada Mountain, Hunshui River passes beneath it, namely Red Water River, east enters Sicheng Prefecture boundary.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Bada Mountain; the Hunshui River runs beneath it as the Red Water River and flows east into Sicheng Prefecture.

translations.literal: Also southwest has Tongshe River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest is the Tongshe River.

translations.literal: Distance to Provincial Administration Commission li.
translations.idiomatic: The distance from the Provincial Administration Commission is given only as li—the numeral is lost in the received text.
